description: A safer autocomplete flow binds tenant scope on the server, uses tenant-aware index filters, and keeps cache/ranking signals isolated.
regression_tests: cross-tenant prefix returns generic empty response
admin search result does not enter user suggestion cache
index alias swap preserves tenant_id and visibility filters
review_note: The flow is a safe comparator because search scope is server-bound, authorization happens before disclosure, and caches, ranking, admin search, and regression evidence preserve tenant boundaries.
